title: Coverage Qualification Standard for the Urological Supply Program
content:
This standard governs when coverage pays for supplies under the Urological Supply Program, and applies when an enrollment is opened and when it is activated.

## Clauses

**1. Permanence and program criteria.** Coverage pays for urological supplies only when the condition is permanent (expected to last at least the program's permanence period in months and documented as indefinite) and the program's criteria documentation is on file:
- for the coudé program, documentation that a straight tip cannot be inserted;
- for the closed-system program, a qualifying criterion, which on the infection ground means at least the program's required number of infections in the 12 months before the criteria documentation date while on sterile intermittent catheters;
- for the all-silicone program, latex allergy or recurrent encrustation.

**2. Order and continued need.** The order must be no older than the program's order validity in months, and continued need must be documented within the program's continued-need period in months.

**3. Prior authorization.** When the primary coverage's class requires prior authorization for urological supplies (the coverage class's urological prior-authorization requirement under Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility) and the program is a prior-authorization program, an enrollment is activated only once a prior authorization request on this holding is approved.

The permanence period, required infections, prior-authorization program flag, order validity and continued-need period are the program's own scheduled figures.

## Clause 1 as a checklist

| Program | Permanence documented as indefinite | Further documentation on file |
|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | required | none named by this clause |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | required | a straight tip cannot be inserted |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | required | a qualifying criterion; on the infection ground, the required infections in the 12 months before the criteria documentation date while on sterile intermittent catheters |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | required | none named by this clause |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | required | latex allergy or recurrent encrustation |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | required | none named by this clause |

## Clause 3, condition by condition

The evidence is the system record: a request of the prior authorization type, its status, and the enrollment it is attached to, together with the class of the patient's primary coverage.

| Primary coverage class requires prior authorization for urological supplies | Program is a prior-authorization program | Effect on activation |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | activated only once a prior authorization request on this enrollment shows approved |
| yes | no | clause 3 does not apply |
| no | yes | clause 3 does not apply |
| no | no | clause 3 does not apply |

- A prior authorization request that is submitted, denied or withdrawn is not an approved request.
- A request approved on a different enrollment is not a request on this holding.

## Hypothetical worked case (infection ground)

A hypothetical Closed-System Catheter Program enrollment shows a criteria documentation date of 15 August and documented infections dated within the 12 months before 15 August while the patient was on sterile intermittent catheters. Clause 1 is met on the infection ground when that count is at least the program's required number; with fewer, the infection ground is not met, and only another qualifying criterion of the closed-system program would meet clause 1.
